items.t: Sudden unintended acceleration or stuck throttle
items.job: Inspect throttle linkage and clean throttle body
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $254–$320 for a Previa throttle body cleaning. If the cruise control, idle control or pedal turns out to be the cause, parts cost more.

items.t: Overheating, coolant loss and blown head gasket
items.job: Replace head gasket and check cooling system
items.note: Costs rise sharply if the head is warped or the engine was badly overheated.

items.t: Front differential can leak oil at high speed (recall)
items.job: Install modified front differential breather plug

items.t: Brake pedal sinks or brakes feel weak
items.note: YourMechanic estimates run about $392 on average and up to about $968 for a 1997. A failed brake booster costs more.

items.t: Vibration through the pedal when braking
items.job: Replace front brake rotors and pads
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $642–$653 for front rotors and pads on a 1996–1997 Previa.

items.t: ABS light on or antilock brakes not working
items.note: A wheel speed sensor is much cheaper if that turns out to be the fault.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifting poorly at high mileage
items.note: Kelley Blue Book lists $6,937–$7,389 at a dealer for a new transmission. A used or rebuilt unit, or fixing a single shift solenoid, can cost less.

items.t: Failed emissions test from clogged EGR passages
items.note: Price assumes cleaning; a new EGR valve adds to parts.

items.t: Worn front struts: clunking and bottoming out
items.note: Owners report an average of about $400. Labor is high because part of the dash comes out.

items.t: Supercharger oil never checked or changed
items.job: Check and top up or change supercharger oil
items.note: Uses genuine Toyota supercharger oil; the unit only holds about 130 ml.

items.job: Rear A/C valve repair and recharge

items.t: Clunk or vibration from the drive shaft coupling
items.job: Replace drive shaft coupling or drive shaft
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $941 for a 1996–1997 Previa drive shaft. Fitting only the coupling kit usually costs less.

items.t: Sliding door or door locks not working
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $272, but a rear door actuator on a supercharged Previa is estimated at about $1,031. Sliding-door rollers or latches are priced separately.
YourMechanic estimates about $421–$440 for 1992–1997 Previas. A bad switch or linkage can cost less.

items.job: Diagnose headlight circuit and replace bulb or switch
items.note: Assumes a bulb or connector fix; a headlight switch costs more.

items.t: Catalytic converter or exhaust pipe failure
items.note: YourMechanic averages $594 and lists Previa-specific estimates of about $1,084–$1,104. Oxygen sensors are extra if needed.

items.t: Power steering fluid leak from the pressure hose
items.note: Shop quotes range widely depending on how much has to be removed to reach the hose.
